# Synology DiskStation DS923+ — 4-Bay Expandable NAS

**Category:** Networking gear / NAS

**MSRP:** $620

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| CPU | AMD Ryzen R1600, dual-core (4-thread), 2.6 GHz base / 3.1 GHz boost |
| Hardware encryption engine | AES-NI |
| Memory | 4 GB DDR4 ECC SODIMM, expandable up to 32 GB (2 slots) |
| Drive bays | 4 x 3.5"/2.5" SATA HDD/SSD, expandable to 9 with DX517 expansion unit |
| M.2 slots | 2 x M.2 2280 NVMe SSD (caching or SSD storage pool) |
| Hot swappable drives | Yes |
| External ports | 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1, 1 x eSATA (expansion port) |
| LAN ports | 2 x 1GbE RJ-45 (Link Aggregation/failover support) |
| Network expansion | Optional E10G22-T1-Mini 10GbE RJ-45 upgrade module |
| Sequential throughput | Up to 625 MB/s read / 559 MB/s write |
| Max single volume size | 108 TB |
| Supported RAID | SHR, Basic, JBOD, RAID 0, 1, 5, 6, 10 |
| File systems | Internal: Btrfs, ext4 · External: Btrfs, ext4, ext3, FAT32, NTFS, HFS+, exFAT |
| Form factor | Desktop |
| Size (H x W x D) | 166 x 199 x 223 mm |
| Weight | 2.24 kg |
| System fans | 2 x 92mm |
| Power supply | 100 W external adapter, 100–240V AC |
| Warranty | 3 years (extendable to 5 in select markets) |

## Notable Features

- Dual-core Ryzen R1600 with ECC RAM support, a step up from the Celeron-based DS920+ predecessor, aimed at Docker/VM workloads.
- Two built-in M.2 2280 NVMe slots that support both SSD caching and standalone SSD storage pools (Synology-branded drives only).
- Expandable to 9 total drive bays via the DX517 expansion unit for growing storage needs.
- Full DSM software stack: Btrfs snapshots, Hyper Backup, Active Backup Suite, Synology Drive, Surveillance Station (up to 40 cameras), and Virtual Machine Manager.
- Optional 10GbE upgrade path via the E10G22-T1-Mini network module for higher-throughput environments.
